rounds.summary: premise+fix Confirmed unit+live; F1 mixed-config gap Confirmed (canary, major); F2 nit.

rounds.head: 2efff36a
rounds.summary: F1 FIXED by follow-up commit 423b4118 (return->continue); proven by author's deterministic contract test; round-1 canary retired as order-dependent. P0 premise+fix re-confirmed live. New commit 2efff36a (rollback-resume) bundled, own tests pass.

premise.claim: A Stateful RoleInstanceSet rollout stalls when fresh-unhealthy instances exhaust the maxUnavailable budget, because the base controller schedules no requeue after the 10s unhealthy window expires.
evidence: unit: TestUpdateStatefulInstanceSetRetriesUnhealthyRollout fails on base (c500c963) with 'retry = 0s, want a positive delay of at most 4s' (no requeue pushed) — results/unit-head.txt.

live (round 1 + round 2, reproducible): BASE binary (c500c963) against the cluster — 'Rolling update budget exhausted' at stateful_instance_set_control.go:618 with NO RequeueAfter; updated=0 for the full 35s observation window (rollout never resumes) — results/live-base-timeline.log, results/live-base-signals.log.

findings.summary: Requeue scheduled only from the first budget-exhausted target; a healthy blocker (no unhealthy-since entry) suppressed the requeue even when a different freshly-unhealthy target had a pending window (mixed-config stall persists).
findings.evidence: Commit 423b4118 ('check lower rollout targets after a budget block') changes the budget-exhausted branch from `return status, nil` to `continue`, so lower freshly-unhealthy targets are no longer blocked by a healthy higher-ordinal stopper. Proven by the author's modified contract test, which now asserts assertWait(reconcile(), 4*time.Second) for the healthy-blocker + lower-unhealthy case: FAILS on base ('retry = 0s, want a positive delay of at most 4s', stateful_instance_set_control_test.go:1012) and PASSES on the fix head (wait=4s), deterministic across 3 isolated runs. The round-1 reviewer canary (TestF1MixedHealthyBlockerStillStalls) is RETIRED: it was order-dependent (leaked global instanceUnhealthySince/durationStore state) — it yielded wait=0 in isolation on BOTH base and fix head, so its round-1 'flip' on the full suite was a false positive; it did not reliably isolate F1. The author's contract test subsumes the guard.

findings.summary: max(time.Until(first.Add(stableUnhealthyDuration)), time.Nanosecond) — the 1ns floor is effectively dead: once the window expired, isStablyUnhealthy is true -> isFree -> the target never reaches this branch.
findings.evidence: isStablyUnhealthy (line 125) checks time.Since(first) >= stableUnhealthyDuration; an expired window flips isFree before the budget-exhausted branch (now line 626 on head), so the 1ns floor is unreachable except via clock skew. Unchanged by the round-2 commits.

findings.summary: Scope expansion: commit 2efff36a ('resume early stateful rollbacks') broadens computeTopology.inRollout via hasStaleBaseInstance + existingSurge-protects-unready-base, adding a distinct rollback-resume behavior beyond issue #464's all-unhealthy repro.
findings.evidence: Adds hasStaleBaseInstance and reworks inRollout to stay true when a stale base instance still needs a revision change even with matching revisions, or when existing surge protects an unready base. New stateful_instance_set_rollback_test.go (197 lines) covers rollback retry / partition / pause / surge cleanup — all PASS on head. The live all-unhealthy repro (maxSurge=0) recovers cleanly (ready=2), no regression. Not a defect, but the PR now carries two fix classes; flagging for author/maintainer awareness.

liveNote: Round 2, HEAD 2efff36a: budget-exhausted log now at stateful_instance_set_control.go:626 (the `continue` branch); 'Finished syncing InstanceSet' result={"Requeue":false,"RequeueAfter":9200854475} (~9.2s, the remaining unhealthy window); requeue fires ~9s later, RIs become stably-unhealthy -> free=true -> replaced with rev2 pods -> ready=2 updated=2 currentRev=rev2. BASE c500c963: 'Rolling update budget exhausted' at line 618, NO RequeueAfter, updated=0 for 35s+.
cluster: ACK 3-node (cn-hongkong), KUBECONFIG ~/.kube/config, CRDs v1alpha2. In-cluster rbgs-controller-manager scaled to 0 during the test, restored to 2 after. Legacy restartPolicy blockers (RI string-form, RIS object-form) that previously blocked the controller are now cleared.
